newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal urges citizens to leave Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Portugal urges citizens to leave Zaire.

text.p: Portugal, which has about 600 citizens in Zaire, urged them to leave on Monday.

"Taking into account the latest developments in Zaire, and aware that the situation in the capital Kinshasa could worsen, the Portuguese government recommends all Portuguese to abandon the country temporarily," the government said in a statement.
Troops of rebel leader Laurent Kabila are advancing on the capital. The government of President Mobutu Sese Seko has reported heavy fighting around Kenge 200 km (125 miles) from Kinshasa.
Portugal sent two planes and 68 troops to Congo this month, in case an evacuation from neighbouring Zaire is needed.
The United States, Britain and France also have several hundred troops in Congo, just across the river from Kinshasa.
